description: Presidential Secretariat - Order Call Out all the members of the Armed Forces for the maintenance of Public Order
categorisation: This gazette content involves the President exercising powers under the Public Security Ordinance to call out armed forces for maintaining public order. This constitutes a legal/regulatory action as it involves the implementation of existing legislation (Public Security Ordinance, Chapter 40) and the issuance of a formal order with legal effect, specifying the areas and forces involved. While it mentions the President by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or constitute a personnel appointment, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
